summary: Behavioral inventory parameters: ansible_connection (any connection plugin, default ssh), ansible_host (real address, don't base on inventory_hostname), ansible_port, ansible_user and ansible_password (always vault it).
questions: How do I set the SSH port for a host?
Is it safe to put ansible_password in inventory?
What connection types can ansible_connection take?

answer_card.title: Core connection variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible_connection`: connection plugin name; SSH types are `ssh` (default) or `paramiko`.
- `ansible_host`: real name/IP if different from the alias. Don't derive it from `inventory_hostname`; use `inventory_hostname_short` if needed so delegation works.
- `ansible_port`: port if not default (22 for SSH).
- `ansible_user`: login user.
- `ansible_password`: login password. **Never store in plain text; use Vault.**
